headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including an 8th home run of the season.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Jack Kochanowicz (Los Angeles Angels) was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Quinn Priester (Milwaukee Brewers) was placed on the 60-day injured list with right thoracic outlet syndrome. Tyler Glasnow (Los Angeles Dodgers) was transferred to the 60-day injured list with low back spasms. Austin Wells (New York Yankees) was placed on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches. Gustavo Campero (Los Angeles Angels) was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture. Jorge Soler (Los Angeles Angels) was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 4, 2026, with a left oblique strain. Brian Fitzpatrick (Milwaukee Brewers) was placed on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow injury. Danny Jansen (Texas Rangers) was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 3, 2026, with a right forearm strain.

Several teams made roster moves and trades. Antoine Kelly was traded from the Los Angeles Dodgers to the Chicago Cubs. Joel Kuhnel was traded from the Athletics to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. Joe La Sorsa was traded from the Pittsburgh Pirates to the Boston Red Sox. Kyle Nicolas was traded from the Cincinnati Reds to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. Austin Wynns was traded from the Los Angeles Angels to the Atlanta Braves for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including a 8th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, with Carter Jensen leading the offense and Matt Strahm earning the win.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals took down the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Matt McLain led the Reds with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the San Francisco Giants 3-2, securing a narrow victory. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 2-3 decision to the Atlanta Braves in their latest matchup. Spencer Horwitz was a notable performer for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox in their latest matchup. Impact hitters for the Phillies included Bryce Harper, Brandon Marsh, Alec Bohm, and Rafael Marchán, while the White Sox saw notable performances from Sam Antonacci and Randal Grichuk.

top_news.title: **Angels RHP Jack Kochanowicz Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-handed pitcher Jack Kochanowicz has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Kelly Heads to Chicago in Trade**
top_news.summary: Antoine Kelly, a left-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Chicago Cubs. The Los Angeles Dodgers dealt Kelly to the Cubs in a trade.
